preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call deprecate()

exploit_hint: As the owner, call deprecate(address _upgradedAddress) to set deprecated=true and point upgradedAddress to an unreviewed or malicious contract. After deprecation, all transfer/transferFrom/approve calls will delegate to the unreviewed upgraded contract through legacy functions, potentially introducing vulnerabilities or backdoors that affect all token holders.
